# Product Hype Intro Call
Date: 2026-11-18 | Duration: 25m

## Summary
Story Snap presented an end-to-end B2B video service covering scripting, storyboarding, voiceover selection, production, and editing, with clients mainly providing reviews and feedback. Product videos were priced from $5K for 30 seconds to $8.5K for 60 seconds, while brand narratives were estimated at $9K–$11K. Ashley felt some samples were too marketing-focused for a developer audience and showed stronger interest in authentic testimonials and executive content. Remote developer testimonials could produce two-minute stories, 30-second cutdowns, advertising edits, and written materials; promotional pricing was $3K per video for five videos, with five customers and two cuts each estimated at approximately $17.2K. Thought-leadership videos could be filmed remotely or onsite, with onsite sessions producing multiple videos efficiently. A potential onsite customer case study was discussed at approximately $8K globally for a two-minute video or $8.3K with an additional cutdown. Dan will send samples and pricing, Ashley will review the options, and follow-up is planned after her return on December 4.

## Keywords
B2B video production, Developer testimonials, Executive thought leadership, Customer case studies, Remote video interviews, On-site video production

## Action Items

Send brand narrative sample link (11:43)
